title: sin-e-phile addon manifest, protocol 1
description: A source described as data (ADR-0006). The normative specification is docs/specs/addon-protocol.md; crates/source-protocol/src/manifest.rs is the reference validator. Three rules cannot be written in JSON Schema and are enforced by the validator only: both endpoints must be on the manifest's own host and port; plain http is allowed only for a loopback host; and the whole document must be at most 65536 bytes and nest at most 8 levels deep.

protocol.description: The protocol version the addon speaks. Only 1 exists.

id.description: Stable identity, conventionally reverse-DNS. Settings and health are stored under it.

name.description: Shown to the user. No control, zero-width or bidirectional-override characters.

version.description: The addon's own version, free-form (semver suggested).

description.description: Shown to the user before they confirm. May contain newlines.

media.description: What the addon can find. Values this app does not know are ignored, but at least one must be known.

homepage.description: A page about the addon, shown as a link.
